# Дизайн Атлас (Design Atlas)

> Анти ИИ-слоп: готовые визуальные системы без «сгенерируй красиво». Сборка — снаружи.

Product: Дизайн Атлас
Marketing promise: Анти ИИ-слоп
Primary language (UI): Russian
Docs language: English
Canonical site: https://design.vaybik.ru
Repository: https://github.com/bilarius1-tech/design-atlas

## Surfaces

- Home: / — brand + entry to Studio (primary) and Cards (secondary)
- Studio: /studio — Template × Style preview → one self-contained design spec (RU+EN, agent or constructor) → build elsewhere
- Cards: /cards — marketplace product-card visual styles → image-gen prompts (RU+EN) → generate elsewhere
- Example site (share with clients): /primer?style={id}&niche=dental|construction|furniture
- Legacy demo index: /demo (links to /primer); /demo/{styleId} redirects to /primer
- Style playground: /playground and /playground/{styleId}
- App chrome / design-system: /design-system
- Connect MCP (human docs): /#mcp
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): /mcp

## How agents should use this service

Connect to `https://design.vaybik.ru/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no key, no repo clone) or call `GET /api/v1/styles/{id}/design-spec?lang=ru|en&surface=agent|constructor`. The MCP tool `get_design_spec` is the same payload. The response includes `markdown` (a complete design specification) and `tokens` (JSON). That markdown is enough: apply the system to the user's current project and create token files there. Do not treat this website as required reading at build time, and do not load Google Fonts or external CDNs.

## Content SSOT (Git)

- Web design systems: content/styles/{id}/
- Page templates: content/templates/{id}/
- Card styles: content/card-styles/{id}/

## Not this product

- Not a site constructor or page builder canvas
- Not an in-product image generator
- Not a design course / encyclopedia-first UX

## Machine-readable maps

- Public JSON API (read-only, free): /api/v1 — see docs/API.md
  - /api/v1/health, /api/v1/styles, /api/v1/styles/{id}/design-spec, /api/v1/shell/tokens, /api/v1/themes/vaybik, /api/v1/components, /api/v1/search?q=
- Remote MCP: POST https://design.vaybik.ru/mcp (Cursor: {"mcpServers":{"design-atlas":{"url":"https://design.vaybik.ru/mcp"}}}). Stdio fallback: packages/mcp
- ZIP export: /api/export/{styleId}?pack=free (contains the same DESIGN-SPEC.ru.md / .en.md)

- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
- This file: /llms.txt
